# GoonBet
> GoonBet is a skill-based multiplayer casino and sports betting platform. Players compete in skill games using virtual tokens — tokens have no real-world monetary value and are not redeemable for cash. GoonBet is 18+ only and promotes responsible play.

GoonBet covers esports and sports betting, plus dozens of arcade and table games playable against the house, AI, or other players in real time. Outcomes are determined primarily by player skill and strategy. The platform uses virtual tokens for all gameplay.
